claim_status: Prospective seed holdout of a development-selected ordinary repair schedule; no claim of a unique RDT prediction.
hypothesis: Six repairs supply more than twice the incremental uninterrupted-success benefit per additional repair call of eighteen repairs, relative to one common initial repair, with positive benefit of continual repair.
population: Uniform mixture of four frozen acquisition-history strata; all sixteen records per independent block. No outcome-based enrollment.
primary_endpoint: Strict both-cue both-port aligned margin >0.25 at every reconstruction generation 15 through 32; all records retained.
criterion: Both G and D have strictly positive one-sided 95% lower paired stratified block-bootstrap bounds. All other results are secondary.

inference.method: Whole-block percentile bootstrap within four equally sized history strata
inference.conjunction: Intersection-union rule; no selection of the easier contrast. Joint type-I control follows marginal coverage approximately; no exact coverage claim.

outcome_rule.CONTRADICTED: Either one-sided 97.5% upper bound <0, Bonferroni guarded across the two possible negative components.
outcome_rule.UNRESOLVED: Otherwise. Failure to meet the supported criterion never becomes evidence of equivalence.

practical_criterion_basis: A twofold gain in benefit per additional call is an explicit research resource target. It requires preserving more than 58.8235% of the added benefit using 29.4118% of additional calls. It does not assert an externally validated tolerance for absolute performance loss.
sampling: 132 blocks from the normal-approximation planning formula, including 25% development-effect shrinkage and 50% within-history variance inflation, targeting 80% one-sided power; see SAMPLE_SIZE.json.
limitations: Call efficiency is not total CPU or physical resource efficiency.
Schedule phase is part of the frozen intervention.
An outcome-informed hypothesis on fresh seeds is not a fresh model family.
Supplied conventional repair and apparatus; no autonomy, minimum budget, equivalence or distinct RDT mechanism.
negative_verdict_multiplicity: Use 97.5% upper component bounds; positive conjunction still uses both one-sided 95% lower bounds.
